profile.ja: 新世代の戦力と期待される若き対魔忍。代々“雷遁の術”使いを輩出する名門で彼女も亡き父親同様、“雷遁の術”を使う。“雷遁の術”とは雷を操る強力な術で攻撃系忍法では最強の火力と言われているもの。その中でも彼女の操る雷撃は強力すぎて制御が難しいため、術を行使する触媒として特別に制作された銃を使用している。ゆきかぜはその銃に雷撃の弾丸を生み出し、強力な雷撃弾を発射する事ができる。二丁拳銃を得物に、舞うように雷撃弾を放つその姿から“雷撃の対魔忍”の異名を持つ。勝気で負けず嫌い、プライドの高さが玉にキズ。とにかく体を動かして遊ぶのが好きで年中日焼けしている美少女。
profile.en: She is a young Taimanin expected to become the next-generation fighting force. Hailing from a prestigious family that has produced generations of thunder-style ninjutsu users, she also wields thunder-style ninjutsu like her late father. This powerful art manipulates lightning and is said to have the strongest firepower among offensive ninjutsu. Because her lightning strikes are so intense they're hard to control, she uses a specially crafted gun as a catalyst. Yukikaze generates lightning-charged bullets in the gun and can fire devastating lightning projectiles. Armed with twin pistols, she dances across the battlefield firing lightning rounds, earning her the nickname "Thunder-strike Taimanin." She is headstrong, hates losing, and her pride is only softened by her childhood friend Akiyama Tatsuro, the one person she can truly trust. She worries that she can't advance their relationship. A perpetual sun-kissed beauty, she loves to stay active and play outdoors all year round.

text.ja: あ、あのさ……これ、あんたの子、らしいんだけどぉ……責任、取るわよね？　ぜ、絶対取ってもらうんだからね！
text.en: Um, uh… this looks like it's your baby, you know… you'll take responsibility, right? I'm absolutely making you take it!

text.ja: ちょっと、フライドポテト買ってきて欲しいんだけど～？　ふふふ、あんたをアゴで使えるのは、少し気分がいいわね
text.en: Hey, could you pick up some french fries for me? Hehe, it's kind of fun using you as a chin.

text.ja: 実際に妊娠してみて思ったのは、想像していたよりもずっと不思議で、それでいて想像していたよりもずっと現実だったって所かしら
text.en: Actually, being pregnant made me realize it's far more mysterious than I imagined, and at the same time way more real than I expected.

text.ja: 激しい運動もできないし、食べ物も制限されるし、もう二度となりたくないわね。ま、あんたがどうしてもっていうなら……なってあげるけど
text.en: I can't do intense exercise, my diet's restricted, I never want to go through that again. But if you really insist… I'll become one, okay.

text.ja: 事情を知らない人に見られるたびにぎょっとされるのがイヤなのよね、私は確かに小さい方だけど……もう立派に産める歳なんですけどぉ？
text.en: I hate being stared at by people who don't know the situation. I'm definitely on the smaller side, but I'm already old enough to give birth properly, you know?

text.ja: このお腹じゃ、アイドル活動はしばらく自粛しなくちゃね……一年間海外で活動とか言っておこうかしら。へっ、逆にバレる？　どうして？
text.en: With this belly, I'll have to pause idol activities for a while… maybe I'll say I'm going overseas for a year. Huh, would that get me found out? Why?

text.ja: もしかしたら、お母さんも……私がお腹の中にいた時は、こんな気持ちだったのかな……
text.en: Maybe Mom… when I was in her belly, she felt something like this…

text.ja: あ、あのさ、雷遁の術を使うのってお腹の子に悪かったりしないかしら？　まあ私が感電してない時点で大丈夫だと思うけれど、心配で
text.en: Hey, do you think using thunder-style ninjutsu could be bad for the baby? Well, as long as I'm not getting electrocuted it should be fine, but I'm worried.

text.ja: あはぁぁ、まだお腹の中にいるのにぃ、もう次の子を孕みたくて、マンコぎゅうぎゅうチンポ絞っちゃって、はあぁ、孕みたい、孕みたいぃ
text.en: Ahh, even though the baby's still inside, I already want to get pregnant again, squeezing my pussy around his cock, ahh, I want to get pregnant, I want to…

text.ja: うぐううぅ、はあぁ、気持ちいいぃ、赤ちゃん守るためにぎゅうって力籠ってる子宮口ぉ、亀頭でごんごんされるの、きぼぢいぃのおぉぉ
text.en: Ugh, ahh, it feels so good, my cervix is tightening to protect the baby, being pounded by his head…

text.ja: うっ、お、ほぉっ、お、お腹ぶるんぶるんっ、しゅごい……ご、ごめんね、あなたの事『気持ちいい』に使っちゃうママで、ごめんねぇ……
text.en: Ugh, oh, my belly's all wobbly… wow… I'm sorry, I'm a mom who's using you for "feeling good," sorry…
